method: Same-agent English/Marathi close reading, formula/token comparison and reverse paraphrase with directly checked native terminology; not independent or human review.
scope: The introductory account of truth-functional propositional logic, inductive syntax, valuation satisfaction, tautology, entailment and satisfiability.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Propositional formulas are built from propositional variables with five displayed connectives. Variables stand for true-or-false sentences or propositions. Truth-functional semantics determines compound truth values from component truth values, considers only true and false, and leaves modal, epistemic, temporal, gappy and partial truth aside. Material implication is truth-functional, while other logics treat non-truth-functional conditionals.
samples.checks: All five connectives, both truth-value constants, every exclusion, the contentious-English-conditional qualification and the contrast with other logics are preserved without strengthening the claim.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Syntax constructs formulas from variables and primitive connectives; systems can vary symbols, primitives and parentheses, including Polish notation. Formation rules define formulas inductively and uniquely readably, enabling inductive meaning definitions. Semantics assigns true or false to variables through a valuation, extends the value to every formula, defines satisfaction by value true, and equivalently defines it by structural induction using truth functions.
samples.checks: The target preserves the alternative-system latitude, parenthesis-free example, unique-readability consequence, total valuation assignment, iff condition, displayed satisfaction notation and structural-induction direction.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A formula is a tautology when every valuation satisfies it; A follows from Gamma when every valuation satisfying all formulas in Gamma satisfies A; a formula set is satisfiable when one valuation satisfies all members simultaneously. Inductive formula and satisfaction definitions support semantic proofs and relations among these notions.
samples.checks: Universal and existential quantifier force, simultaneous satisfaction, the difference between tautology and entailment, all displayed symbols and both induction claims are preserved.

limitations: No independent linguistic review has been performed.
